programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: The Royal Melbourne Hospital is non-stop 24/7. Dr Mark Putland examines a quarry worker’s mangled arm. Dr Jonathan Papson carefully removes a screw from a patient’s thumb after a home DIY mishap.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: At The Royal Melbourne Hospital, time is critical as Dr Scott Taylor’s unresponsive patient deteriorates with a suspected brain bleed. Dr Tristan Harding must straighten a young man’s dislocated ankle before the blood supply cuts off.
